goals.title: Decide `tutor`'s session-saving question
goals.detail: Ephemeral in-chat only vs. a dated-file log like ianlogger's.
goals.context: report-viewer's Recent Nuggets panel is already wired to surface tutor's recent entries the moment there's a log.md to read - right now nothing gets saved, so nothing shows up. Real dependency: this one decision unblocks that panel.

goals.title: Decide whether `Template Creator`/`Script Creator`/`Reusable Task Tools` are one idea or three
goals.detail: All three are still bare Idea-stage entries touching the same ground.
goals.context: productize (fleshed out separately) touches similar territory from a different angle - worth settling how many distinct projects this actually is before any of the three get built out further.
